description: How far along am I in a program at a school I am considering? One checklist at any target school, chosen by its name or title (or its checklist_id), line by line against what a person holds. Each held item is compared through the combined check. Two equal sources, four steps run side by side: (1) comparability direct from CourseShelf - the receiver's own published mappings; (2) known equivalencies direct from CourseAtlas, live - what institutions report, CollegeBoard's among them as CourseAtlas carries them; (3) inferred comparability from CourseShelf's comparability anchors (hop 1: an exam at a shared score, a state course, a mapping, crossing kinds); (4) inferred equivalency from CourseAtlas's equivalency anchors (hop 2, its own chain). `kind` narrows them: known runs 1 and 2, inferred runs 3 and 4, both runs all four. Each landing is joined to the checklist's lines; a GoldRibbon package, when given, adds the lines its prior learning may meet. Each line is met (a known mapping lands a held item on it), reached_by_inference (only an inferred landing reaches it: shown with its path of published links, never counted as met), may_be_met_by_prior_learning, or open, with every way it is reached. Each group gives its lines by state beside the choice rule it prints. Last, what does not count: each held item that reaches no line, with its reason (no rule, below the score, landing on a course this checklist does not require, unresolved, not held, or a source not read - never an absence). A case to show the school, not a verdict; recognition is the school's act. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

carried.description: Set by `continue.arguments`: the map's progress so far, sent back unchanged

checklist.description: The checklist's name or title at the target (its award title), e.g. Nursing BSN; several fitting are listed, never guessed

checklist_id.description: Or the checklist's id, from find_checklists

held.description: 0 to 20 things held, each as comparable_map takes one: a course { unitid or school, code }, an exam { program, exam, score }, { learning_unit_id } or { certification_ctid }. Compared 5 per call: an answer with more to compare carries `continue.arguments` to send back as they are

held_offset.description: Set by `continue.arguments`: the held item to start this call's 5 from

package.description: Optional: the person's GoldRibbon package; its prior learning is read on the first call for the lines it may meet

sources.description: Optional information-source selection: all (default), or a nonempty array of distinct numbers: 1 gathered published CourseShelf comparables, 2 school-published CourseAtlas equivalencies, 3 inferred CourseShelf comparability through anchors, 4 inferred CourseAtlas equivalency through anchors. Any combination is allowed. An explicit kind intersects this selection; an empty intersection is invalid. Unselected engines report not_requested. Required identity/reference reads may still be needed. Send continuation arguments unchanged.

target_unitid.description: The school whose checklist is mapped, by IPEDS UNITID, e.g. 240727

name: checklist_map

candidates.description: When the name fits several checklists, or none

compared.description: Cumulative item summaries across pages: item, state, reason, lines_reached and incomplete. An incomplete read is not evidence that no mapping exists.

comparison_scope.description: This page's held_offset, compared_through and total of; comparisons are page-local while compared and line progress remain cumulative

comparisons.description: Full combined answers for this page only: held identity and read_as, state/reason/statement, known mappings, exam tiers with held score placed, inferred landings with supplied paths and conditions, lands_as with applicability, checklist_lines and steps. Retain every page's comparisons; they are not carried into continuation

complete.description: Pagination completion: every held item has been visited. Source reads may still be incomplete; inspect compared and the detailed comparison steps.

continue.description: When more held items remain: compared_through, of, and the arguments for the next call (the next 5, with the progress carried)

counts.description: Line states: met only where shared applicability support establishes an unconditional known or earned receiver-owned landing; inferred, prior-learning and open remain separate. Conditional evidence is retained without a met claim; group allocation determines program progress.

credits.description: The lines' printed credits, summed by state, each its own

credits_basis.description: Labels credits as sums of line states; these are not allocated program completion credits

does_not_count.description: Each held item that reaches no line: item, reason, statement. Timeout, unread source, unreadable minimum, inactive rule, unresolved target course and a completed search finding no rule are distinct. Landings remain in this page's comparisons even when applicability is unresolved

groups.description: Actual group ID, published rule, non-additive status and separate confirmed/inferred_potential allocations, surplus, remaining item IDs/choices, credit lower bounds, nullable satisfaction and missing evidence

lines.description: Every line: its actual line_group_id and heading, item identity, alternatives, printed credit fields, state and reached_by (each way: how, held item, actual receiving learning unit, lands_as, band, rule or path, rests_on, minimum_grade, also_needs). held_at_receiver is own-course applicability; unconfirmed earned evidence is not met

program_progress.description: Published denominator and group-constrained allocations, confirmed progress separately from inferred potential. Each scenario retains allocations, remaining groups, missing inputs, lower bounds and nullable exact applied_credits, credits_remaining and percent_complete. Receiving-unit credits count once. Missing policy, conditions, credit totals or compatible units prevent exact claims. pagination_complete and source_incomplete state the scope of the evidence

source_reads_complete.description: Whether selected source evidence completed, distinct from held-item pagination. A response-window limit, failed read or retained incomplete page prevents a complete-source claim; checklist_map includes prior-learning evidence in this scope.

title: Checklist Map
